title: Join the townhall
summary: The weekly call in the site: join, the controls, the slides and your attendance.

steps.text: Join the call from here (or the Townhall card). It opens 15 minutes before the townhall.
Allow your camera and microphone, then Join the call. Being in the call counts your attendance by itself.
Mute, turn your camera off, share your screen or leave from this bar.
The slides follow the presenter. Previous and Next let you look on your own; Back to the presenter catches up.
Raise your hand to speak, and use Chat to write to everyone.
